label: Futuristic Location
description: Near-future cityscapes and megastructures. Tagged 'scifi' for genre-filtered templates.

items.name: blade-runner-district
items.text: A rain-hazed street in a future financial district, monolithic towers faced with colossal animated holographic advertisements, their colors pooling on the wet lanes below.

items.name: high-tech-street
items.text: A high-tech city street, seamless glass facades with glowing architectural seams, embedded light strips guiding silent traffic between minimalist towers.

items.name: space-station-hangar
items.text: Inside an orbital station hangar bay, deck lighting strips converging on the open aperture where the blue curve of Earth hangs, service drones docked along the gantry walls.

items.name: underwater-tunnel
items.text: A transparent acrylic tunnel through a vast dark aquarium, rays and silver bait balls drifting over the curved ceiling, caustic light rippling along the walkway.

items.name: skybridge-plaza
items.text: A glass skybridge plaza strung between two supertowers, clouds drifting below the transparent floor.

items.name: vertical-garden-atrium
items.text: A vast solarpunk atrium, terraced vertical gardens cascading down sunlit white architecture.

items.name: maglev-platform
items.text: A floating maglev platform at height, guideways curving off between the towers into haze.

items.name: fusion-plant-hall
items.text: The cathedral hall of a fusion plant, the torus vessel glowing faint blue behind layered containment glass.

items.name: rooftop-vertiport
items.text: A rooftop vertiport at tower height, illuminated landing rings and windsocks among antenna masts, numbered pads waiting for air taxis.

items.name: charging-plaza
items.text: A canopied hypercharging plaza, light-guide strips pulsing along each stall as liquid-cooled cables arc to waiting vehicles, status rings glowing beneath a photovoltaic roof.

items.name: seawall-crest-road
items.text: A service road along the crest of a megastructure tidal seawall, marker lights embedded in the parapet, turbine halls humming below and open ocean stretching to the far side.
